get.description: Returns the retained prediction, operator review and compatible authoritative outcome. Returns null when no evaluation is recorded.
get.summary: Read the latest Shadow evaluation for a case and Workflow

post.description: Evaluate the current diagnosis and bound Workflow proposal without executing it. Set workflow to the Workflow definition ID. Missing candidates are retained. Reuse the evaluation ID for exact retries.
post.summary: Evaluate a resolution in Shadow Mode

post.description: Record the observed operator action, eligibility assessment and optional trust feedback with evidence from this incident. The first review is retained; conflicting retries return 409. Authoritative outcomes are read separately from verification history.

get.description: Owners and admins can compare up to 500 incidents for one Workflow within a time window. The latest evaluation per incident is counted. Rates include denominators and exclude unknown observations. Predictions are conditional simulations, not executed or verified resolutions.
get.summary: Compare Shadow predictions with observed outcomes

get.description: Returns recorded events newest first by recorded timestamp and immutable ID. Date bounds apply to recorded time, including from and excluding to, for at most 366 days. Search matches issue ID, persisted target reference, action label, actor ID and workflow run ID (literal, case-insensitive substring). Raw payloads are not searched. Cursors are bound to workspace, role, filters and page size. Connection administration events are visible only to owners and administrators. Approval and provider acceptance do not establish verified resolution.
Members can inspect published versions and activation status. Viewing a playbook never activates it.
Read steps, versions, prerequisites and historical grants. Evaluation evidence is explicitly unavailable when no integrated evaluation source exists.
Returns the 50 most recent runs with issue links and separate execution and verification results. Pilot and unclassified evidence do not establish live success.

post.description: Owners and admins grant their own principal access to explicit orders on one connection. Review the exact digest, scope and approval behavior. Reuse the same ID and body after an uncertain response. Conflicting, overlapping or stale grants return 409; revoked records cannot be restored.
Owners and admins prevent future admission under this artifact. Repeated revocation is safe. Revocation preserves historical grants and does not undo already-dispatched work.

Owners and admins test an exact version with example inputs, capability replies and expected outputs. Evaluation does not call connected systems. Reuse the same ID and body after an uncertain response.

post.summary: Cancel a running Code Step evaluation

post.description: Stops computation and prevents new capability requests. Actions already admitted may still complete and require reconciliation.

get.summary: Read replenishment scopes and current stock

post.description: Owners and admins review a stock position, supplier and quantity limits. Target stock must exceed the minimum. Reuse the exact ID and body when retrying.
Reads current stock on the server and starts the activated version when stock is below its minimum. Reuse the request ID after an uncertain response.
post.summary: Check low stock and start replenishment

get.description: Returns recorded stock, supplier, policy decision, current purchase-order status and independent verification. Only a different authorized owner or admin can respond to a pending proposal.

post.description: A different owner or admin decides on the exact proposal. Current stock, activation and policy are checked again before creating the order.
post.summary: Approve or reject a replenishment proposal

get.description: Members can inspect published versions and activation status. Viewing a workflow never activates it.
Read published steps, versions, prerequisites and historical grants. Process versions show the exact order of decisions, actions, waits and verification.
Returns the 50 most recent runs with subject, actor, trigger and step evidence. Process runs show their current state and recorded outputs. Execution and verification results are separate.

post.description: Owners and admins submit typed signal evidence for an exact version and resource. Reuse the source ID and complete body on retry. Starts do not grant execution authority. Schedules start once at the time specified by the version.
post.summary: Start or schedule a workflow run

post.description: Owners and admins can activate supported Resolution versions for their own principal and explicit orders on one connection. Other definitions remain available for review. Review the exact digest, scope and approval behavior. Reuse the same ID and body after an uncertain response. Conflicting, overlapping or stale grants return 409; revoked records cannot be restored.
Owners and admins prevent future admission under this artifact. Repeated revocation is safe. Revocation preserves historical grants and does not undo already-dispatched work.
Owners and admins can create suppliers. Retry with the same ID and body after an uncertain response.

Owners and admins create a draft with immutable lines and provenance. Luma-owned orders support audited lifecycle changes. External ownership requires an external reference and prevents local lifecycle changes. Reuse the ID and body on retry.

get.summary: Read a purchase order and its lifecycle history

post.description: Owners and admins move drafts to open or cancelled, and open orders to closed or cancelled. Provide the current revision and a reason. Reuse the command ID and body on retry. Closing records completion; it does not record a warehouse receipt.

get.description: Owners and admins can find up to 50 runs for a case. Pass nextCursor as after to continue; IDs provide stable page ordering. Refresh from the first page to discover newly recorded runs.

post.description: Owners and admins record a run ID, diagnosis revision, resolution version and reason. Reuse the run ID for automated steps. Exact retries return the original record; conflicting IDs return 409.

Append cause assessments, repairs, interventions, edits, outcomes or recurrence links. Use codes and incident evidence references. Model hypotheses remain suspected. Verified outcomes require the incident’s authoritative verification. Exact retries return the original event.

get.description: Owners and admins can export the original context, ordered operator records, bound steps, execution and all verification attempts. A pending attempt without completion has no known result. Execution acceptance does not establish business success.
Returns an immutable proposal, its current policy result and permitted decisions. Unavailable capabilities cannot be approved. Manual recommendations remain in the case investigation.

post.description: Checks current source facts and prepares a current proposal where supported. Existing approvals and execution records are preserved. Changed conditions require review; provider unavailability can be retried.
post.summary: Check current facts for a resolution proposal

post.description: Use a unique commandId and the current case, diagnosis, proposal and policy versions from review. Exact retries return the committed receipt. Conflicts return 409. Approval records a decision; it does not mean execution or verification succeeded.
post.summary: Approve, reject or escalate a case

get.description: After a timeout, read the receipt using the original command ID or retry the identical request. Receipts are visible to their submitting actor.
Returns persisted execution and canonical resolution separately from workflow phase. An unavailable workflow service does not imply success or no activity.
Returns up to 100 persisted events, ordered by timestamp and ID. Reuse cursors with the same organization, case and page size. Refresh from the first page and deduplicate by ID as events arrive.

Returns current attention and active counts, up to five decisions ordered by severity then oldest request, and verified resolutions in the selected rolling window [start, end). Connection freshness requires observations for every permitted read capability within 24 hours. Null automation metrics mean eligibility or human-work attribution is unavailable. Counts describe persisted cases; fresh observations do not establish complete source coverage.

Filter attention, active work or history by class, severity and state. Results sort by severity, oldest attention request or detection, then ID. Use the returned cursor with the same filters. Refresh from the first page as cases change.

Returns persisted observation and verification references ordered by immutable ID, including evidence outside the current diagnosis. Pages default to 25 references and allow at most 100. Reuse cursors only for the same organization, case and page size. As evidence arrives, refresh from the first page and deduplicate by ID. Completeness is unknown unless explicitly recorded for the observation. A null source update time means unknown, regardless of observation freshness.

Returns the current persisted investigation and up to 100 evidence references. Use the evidence endpoint to read further historical references. Recommendations require review; they do not authorize execution. Unavailable cases return not found.

post.description: Creates an EU organization with you as its owner. Other regions are unavailable.
Owners and admins can add users. Only owners can grant ownership.
post.summary: Add a registered user to an organization

delete.description: The last owner cannot be removed or demoted.

get.summary: Check whether your settings command committed
Read workspace settings and your email preferences

patch.summary: Update the workspace name and display timezone

patch.description: Owners and admins may strengthen approval requirements. Platform denials and required approvals always apply. Changing this preference invalidates previous policy reviews.
patch.summary: Require independent approval for otherwise permitted changes

post.summary: Queue a test email to your account

post.description: Sending an invitation does not grant access. An existing pending invitation must be resent or revoked; existing members cannot be invited.
Resending replaces the previous link and starts a new seven-day expiry.

post.summary: Review an invitation for your signed-in email
Accept a single-use invitation for your signed-in email

post.description: Owners and admins can submit credentials. The connection remains pending until a successful permission check.
Replaces credentials and clears verified permissions. Check the connection again to restore access. Use the latest connection version.
Deletes stored credentials and stops further use. Does not revoke provider tokens or cancel requests already sent. Install a new connection to reconnect.

get.summary: List available apps and workspace installations

post.description: Owners and admins can install an available app. Use null for a first installation or the current version to reinstall.
post.summary: Install an app in this workspace

post.description: Stops new app operations and deletes its connection credentials. Historical records remain. Requests already dispatched may finish.

get.summary: Check whether the API is running

get.description: Returns 200 when ready and 503 when temporarily unavailable.
get.summary: Check whether the API is ready to serve requests

get.description: Browse provider names and categories. Filter by storefront or ERP.
Look up a provider by its ID. Returns 404 if the provider is not in the catalog.

Authenticated SSE emits resync events with a current progress snapshot every five seconds. Refetch case, review and timeline on each event and reconnect. Last-Event-ID always resynchronizes current state; events are not an audit replay. Sessions and membership are checked before each snapshot. Streams reconnect after one minute. Slow consumers are disconnected. Use the timeline endpoint for persisted history.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Reconnects with a fresh authoritative snapshot.

200.description: SSE resync events carrying a CaseProgress snapshot and refetch: true.

info.title: Luma API
info.description: Read cases, evidence, proposals, execution and audit history. Make permitted decisions and follow authenticated progress streams. Manage organizations, memberships and installed connections. Organization endpoints require a session cookie.
